name: Chideng Jianye
source:
An Illuminator of ancient civilization and Noxistasia's tutor.

[spoiler]Ms. Farlight later became a member of the nobility with her own effort. As a result, she was incredibly powerful and knowledgeable. She helped all those who were discriminated against and overlooked because she thought there should not be any difference between Illuminators.[/spoiler]
